# Arch Linux AUR — aggregate6

This directory contains PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO for the
[AUR](https://aur.archlinux.org/) package of `aggregate6`.

## Structure

```
dist/archlinux/
├── PKGBUILD     # Arch build recipe
└── .SRCINFO     # AUR metadata (auto-generated)
```

## Installation

### From AUR (once published)

```bash
# Using yay
yay -S aggregate6

# Using paru
paru -S aggregate6
```

### Manual build

```bash
cd dist/archlinux
makepkg -si
```

## Publishing to AUR

### Initial setup

```bash
# 1. Create an AUR account at https://aur.archlinux.org/
# 2. Add your SSH public key to your AUR profile
# 3. Clone the (empty) AUR package repo:
git clone ssh://aur@aur.archlinux.org/aggregate6.git /tmp/aggregate6-aur
```

### Upload / update

```bash
# 1. Copy package files
cp dist/archlinux/PKGBUILD /tmp/aggregate6-aur/
cp dist/archlinux/.SRCINFO /tmp/aggregate6-aur/

# 2. Commit and push
cd /tmp/aggregate6-aur
git add PKGBUILD .SRCINFO
git commit -m "Update to version X.Y.Z"
git push
```

### Regenerating .SRCINFO

The `.SRCINFO` file is auto-generated by `dist/update-dist.sh` during releases.
To regenerate manually (requires `pacman`/`makepkg`):

```bash
cd dist/archlinux
makepkg --printsrcinfo > .SRCINFO
```

## Checksum updates

The `sha256sums` field is automatically updated by `dist/update-dist.sh`
during the release process. For manual builds, regenerate with:

```bash
cd dist/archlinux
updpkgsums
```
